thread:
maria_sales: Hey team — customer (FinCo) wants the POC IR / breach-notice wording for Hosted vs VPC. They asked for exact timelines and who we notify. Can we get a short playbook they can share with their legal/ops?
alex_se: Quick Q — do they need contract language or just an ops-level example?
maria_sales: Legal wants example timelines + contact points. Ops wants to know whether we support 24h triage, 72h regulator notification, etc.
sam_security: We have standard guidance: we triage incidents within 4 hours of detection for Hosted accounts, escalation to SOC in 1 hour if severity >= P2. For Private deployments the customer typically manages notification but we provide artifacts and IR support under the contract.
alex_se: Can you give concrete timelines to share? FinCo wants to include in their RFP.
sam_security: Yes — suggested public-facing snippet: `We will notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming a data breach that affects customer data. For incidents that are likely to materially impact availability or confidentiality we will initiate triage within 4 hours and provide a substantive status update within 24 hours.` Feel free to shorten.
olivia_ops: +1 on that. For Hosted we also have an internal SLA: initial acknowledgement to customer ≤ 2 business hours for P1, full incident report within 14 days for most breaches (30 days for complex forensic cases).
maria_sales: That's helpful. Any difference for POC/test accounts?
sam_security: POC accounts get the same initial triage and updates, but post-incident forensic deliverables may be limited unless under enterprise contract. Add a line: `POC customers may receive redacted reports or a summary unless a Support/Ent addendum is in place.`
jane_ciso: Also note legal/regulatory timelines: if customer is in EU, they may have 72-hour regulator reporting obligations — we can help with evidence but customers often retain responsibility for regulator filing.
alex_se: Can we provide a one-paragraph template they can paste into an RFP?
sam_security: Sure — `Template: Redwood Inference will treat security incidents seriously. We maintain a SOC-led incident response process: initial triage within 4 hours, escalation to on-call within 1 hour for high-severity events, customer notification within 72 hours after confirmation of a breach that affects customer data, and a final incident report within 14–30 days depending on complexity. For Private/VPC deployments, notification responsibilities are outlined in the deployment agreement; Redwood will furnish forensic artifacts and collaborate on regulatory filings as agreed.`
maria_sales: Perfect. Can ops provide contact points — who should FinCo call/email during POC?
olivia_ops: Use ir@redwood.ai for Hosted POCs, and include `ir-oncall` pager for escalation. I'll DM the direct on-call schedule.
ir-bot: Incident template doc created: https://redwood.share/poc-ir-template (autogenerated)
alex_se: One last: CAIQ/SIG asks about evidence for IR capability. What artifacts can we promise for POC?
sam_security: We can provide SOC2 report excerpts, IR runbook summary, retention of logs for 90 days (hosted), and a high-level timeline of IR drills. For deeper artifacts (full logs, forensic images) we require NDA/contract.
maria_sales: I’ll package this with pricing note: hosted POC includes basic IR support; enterprise ent. add-on for forensic support.
olivia_ops: I'll drop a short email template in thread in a sec.
olivia_ops: `Email template to customer:`
```
Subject: Redwood POC — Incident Response & Notification
Hi Team,
Per your request, here’s our POC incident response summary: initial triage within 4 hours, escalation to on-call within 1 hour for high-severity events, customer notification within 72 hours post-confirmation, and final report in 14–30 days. For VPC/on-prem, Redwood will coordinate and provide artifacts as contractually agreed. For forensic deliverables we require an enterprise addendum.
Contact: ir@redwood.ai (Hosted POCs)
Looking forward to next steps — Maria
```
maria_sales: Great — I’ll send this to FinCo now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alex_se: Thanks, team. Will update deal notes.
sam_security: Ping me if legal pushes for language changes.
